name: Vanderbilt University
character: The campus features eclectic buildings of various styles along ridge lines, surrounded by abundant green space and roughly 190 species of trees and shrubs.

landmarks.name: Kirkland Hall
landmarks.quote: One of these is Kirkland Hall, one of the more recognizable buildings on campus.
landmarks.look: Italianate-style building with a single tower

landmarks.name: Heard Central Library
landmarks.quote: Additionally, the Heard Central Library and Sarratt Student Center/Rand Hall can be found on the original campus.

landmarks.name: Vanderbilt Stadium

landmarks.name: Carmichael Towers

landmarks.name: Branscomb Quadrangle
